model: released Fast-WAM Optional-IDM clean checkpoint; idm mode

transform.name: smooth05_hadamard
transform.source: reuse exact saved transforms from original successful full banks; no refitting or alpha search

weight_scope: all 614 target Linears; video306/action307/root-proprio1; no highprecision restoration branch
activation: dynamic per-row signed symmetric absmax A4 qmax7; decoded BF16
unquantized: KV cache, bias, normalization, nonlinearities, text encoder, VAE and other non-target modules

microscaling.axis: input dimension within each output row
microscaling.row_gain: reuse exact existing BF16 row RMS
microscaling.books_shared: two books shared within each Linear
microscaling.metric: same A4 input diagonal second moment multiplied by actual block scale squared

reuse.teacher_actions: new shared teacher/results query_records on the fixed four-suite held-out demo cohort
reuse.moments: recompute per-context BF16W+A4 moments on new original-only cohorts; atomic checkpoint
reuse.local_diagnostics: new moment-weighted weight errors only; no old Spatial teacher sensitivity captures

evaluation.primary_metric: first10 x6 motor RMSE versus same-input same-seed BF16; average seeds within case, cases within suite, then four suites equally
evaluation.method_selection: none; only c8 and c80 predetermined
evaluation.heldout: same tasks; different demonstration IDs for calibration/test, original-only; no unseen-task claim

claim_scope: Calibration cohort comparison for decoded-BF16 B32 additive VQ; C8 vs C80 changes task/context/phase coverage; no unseen-task, native kernel, speed or closed-loop claim

data.input_source: original demonstration states restored into original LIBERO environment; no initial-state substitution

moments.normalization: each context normalize token-row sum by row count; equal context and equal suite weights
moments.reuse: same original C80 rendered input pool; C8 nested subset; transforms and VQ budget fixed
